confidence: Low. Almost everyone now has a credible grievance; poison and toast access matter more than anger alone.
plausibility_notes: Grant coercing many participants fits an exaggerated dinner-party villain, though twenty-two simultaneous confessions make the event feel deliberately populated with motives.
All statements share polished confession-plus-grievance structure; no suspect stands out on prose style.
Artie having another job meaningfully weakens the simplest resignation motive.
Dada admitting the warning supplies a fair alternate explanation and should not automatically clear him.
Several confessions explain distinct compromises coherently, but repeated Grant-wanted-me-to-repeat-a-falsehood motifs can blur characters.
